NEW YORK (AP) — Here are a selection of the winners at the 2026 Tony Awards.

“Schmigadoon!,” an adaptation of an Apple TV series that gently mocks big, brassy Broadway shows, won the best new musical and actor John Lithgow, 80, became the oldest man ever to win a competitive acting Tony. (June 8)
